card.name: Just before the word cell in biology text
card.fires_on: Points in cell-biology text or journal citations where the next word is likely 'cell' or 'cells' (e.g. a journal volume and colon after Cell, or a linking word before cytoplasm and cell terms).

modes.label: Journal citations
modes.description: Punctuation after a volume number in a citation to a cell-biology journal such as J Cell Biol or Cell.

modes.label: Cell-biology prose
modes.description: Linking or list words inside text about cells, where another cell term comes next.
modes.example: Stem cells<< become>> mature blood cells by a process called differentiation

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the word cells and its variants, so the next word is not predicted as cell.
card.plain: It fires in cell-biology text and citations where the word cell would otherwise come next, and holds that word back.
